\section{Tight-binding model}\label{sec:model}
We consider a finite chain of length $L$ with nearest-neighbour hopping $t>0$.
\begin{defn}[Chain Hamiltonian]\label{def:ham}
On $\Hilb_L = \mathbb{C}^L$, the open-boundary Hamiltonian acts as
\begin{equation}\label{eq:ham}
(H_L \psi)_j = -t(\psi_{j-1} + \psi_{j+1}) + v_j \psi_j.
\end{equation}
\end{defn}
